name: mathterm
description: An Electron terminal with math-aware rich rendering, LaTeX/Markdown display, inline images, prompt navigation, and exportable math views.
author: Rixin Li

scripts.test: node test/backendLifecycle.test.js && node test/outputTransport.test.js && node test/headlessWriteBatcher.test.js && node test/headlessTerminalState.test.js && node test/headlessTerminalBudget.test.js && node test/runtimeIds.test.js && node test/shellShim.test.js && node test/terminalMetadata.test.js && node test/ptyManager.test.js && node test/cliOptions.test.js && node test/windowBounds.test.js && node test/layoutTree.test.js && node test/ansi.test.js && node test/latex.test.js && node test/latexMacros.test.js && node test/richVirtual.test.js && node test/mathSearch.test.js && node test/sessionFormat.test.js && node test/session.test.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder.js --linux AppImage deb rpm
scripts.dist:linux:packages: npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder.js --linux deb rpm
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder.js --mac dmg zip
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder.js --mac dir
